column1: # These are the numbers NVIDIA's CUDA Occupancy Calculator (and
# block) tuple. Each row is derived below by hand from two published inputs so a
# reviewer can check it without running caliper:
#   (a) the per-SM limits from the CUDA C Programming Guide
#   (b) the allocation rules from cuda_occupancy.h: registers are allocated per
#       warp with the whole-warp total rounded up to 256; the warp count the
#       register file then holds is rounded down to 4; shared memory per block is
#       (request + reserved) rounded up to the 128 B allocation unit.
# active_blocks (a tunable resource is named before a hard cap).

column4: 256   : regs/warp=1024; warps held=64; byRegs=64/8=8; byWarps=32/8=4 -> 4 blocks
256   : regs/warp=1024; warps held=64; byRegs=64/8=8; byWarps=64/8=8; maxBlocks=32
